def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def parse_all(txt):
    ch={}
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if not(l.startswith("ATOM") or l.startswith("HETATM")): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in t2o or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        c=l[21]; key=(int(l[22:26]),l[26]); at=l[12:16].strip()
        d=ch.setdefault(c,{}); d.setdefault(key,dict(aa=t2o[rn],atoms={},b=0.0))
        d[key]['atoms'][at]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        if at=="CA": d[key]['b']=float(l[60:66])
    return ch

Mx=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62raw.strip().split("\n")])
B62={(AAo[i],AAo[j]):Mx[i,j] for i in range(20) for j in range(20)}
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=int)
    F[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m); F[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            d=F[i-1,jj-1]+B62.get((a[i-1],b[jj-1]),-4)
            u=F[i-1,jj]+(ge if P[i-1,jj]==1 else go)
            l=F[i,jj-1]+(ge if P[i,jj-1]==2 else go)
            k=int(np.argmax([d,u,l])); F[i,jj]=[d,u,l][k]; P[i,jj]=k
    i,jj=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 or jj>0:
        if i>0 and jj>0 and P[i,jj]==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1)); i-=1; jj-=1
        elif i>0 and P[i,jj]==1: i-=1
        else: jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def superpose(P,Q,cut=4.0,iters=10):
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for _ in range(iters):
        Pk,Qk=P[keep],Q[keep]
        pm,qm=Pk.mean(0),Qk.mean(0)
        V,Sv,Wt=np.linalg.svd((Pk-pm).T@(Qk-qm)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))
        R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
        dev=np.sqrt((((P-pm)@R+qm-Q)**2).sum(1))
        new=dev<cut
        if new.sum()<30: break
        if (new==keep).all(): keep=new; break
        keep=new
    Pk,Qk=P[keep],Q[keep]; pm,qm=Pk.mean(0),Qk.mean(0)
    V,Sv,Wt=np.linalg.svd((Pk-pm).T@(Qk-qm)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
    rms_core=float(np.sqrt((((Pk-pm)@R+qm-Qk)**2).sum()/len(Pk)))
    dev_all=np.sqrt((((P-pm)@R+qm-Q)**2).sum(1))
    return int(keep.sum()),rms_core,float(np.sqrt((dev_all**2).mean()))

def seg(ch,lo,hi):

    nk,rc,ra=superpose(P,Q)
    out[nm]=(len(pr),idt,nk,rc,ra)
    print(f"{nm}: {len(pr)} aligned CA pairs, {idt:.1f}% identity -> core {nk} CA at RMSD {rc:.2f} A (all-pair RMSD {ra:.2f} A)")
